home.title: Internet, phones and billing for your business. One monthly price.
home.body: Answer five quick questions. We suggest what fits your shop or office, show the full price, and you finish the paperwork on your phone.
home.skip: I know what I need: see prices

chat.title: Advisor
chat.q_type: Namaste! What kind of business do you run?
chat.q_employees: How many people work there, including you?
chat.q_sites: How many locations do you need connected?
chat.q_city: Which kind of city are you in?
chat.q_gstin: Do you have a GST number? Some services need an active GST registration.
chat.done: Thanks. I have what I need to suggest a plan.
chat.invalid_number: Please enter a number, for example 4.
chat.start_error: Could not reach the advisor. Check that the API is running, then reload.

quote.title: Your monthly price
quote.no_profile: Tell us about your business first.
quote.gst_note: Some services are hidden because they need an active GST registration.
quote.status_superseded: This plan was replaced by a newer one.

kyc.title: Business documents
kyc.consent_body: We use these documents only to verify your business for this connection. Images are deleted within 30 days; we keep only the checked details. You can withdraw consent at any time, which deletes your documents straight away.
kyc.consent_required: I agree to KYC verification for this order (required)
kyc.need_price: Get a price first so we know which connection this is for.
kyc.docs_help: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB each. A clear photo from your phone is fine.
kyc.docs_after_identity: Check your registration first so we know which documents you need.
kyc.too_big: This file is larger than 5 MB. Take a smaller photo and try again.
kyc.wrong_type: Upload a JPEG, PNG or PDF.

overall.incomplete: Upload the remaining documents to finish.
overall.review: All documents are in. A reviewer will confirm them, usually within a few hours.
overall.fail: Something needs fixing. See the item marked below.

kyc.withdraw: Withdraw consent and delete my documents
kyc.withdraw_confirm: This deletes every document you uploaded and stops verification. Continue?
kyc.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. Your documents were deleted.
kyc.on_file: On file: {value}. Leave blank to keep it.

track.title: Order status
track.not_found: We couldn't find this order. Open the link from your WhatsApp message.
track.error: Could not load the order. Try again.
track.updates_note: You get a WhatsApp message at every step. No need to call.

units.line: {count, plural, one {# mobile line} other {# mobile lines}}
units.channel: {count, plural, one {# phone line} other {# phone lines}}
units.counter: {count, plural, one {# billing counter} other {# billing counters}}
units.IP: {count, plural, one {# fixed IP} other {# fixed IPs}}

checkout.title: Confirm and pay
checkout.contract: {months}-month contract. Monthly charges start when your services are working.
checkout.phone_help: We send WhatsApp updates here. No calls needed.
checkout.method_upi_autopay_help: Approve once in your UPI app; the monthly bill is collected automatically.
checkout.method_razorpay_help: Pay by card or netbanking each month.
checkout.test_mode: Test mode: no money is taken in this prototype.
checkout.pay_error: Payment did not go through. Nothing was charged; try again.

whatif.open: What if my budget or needs change?
whatif.title: Change something and see what happens
whatif.help: Set a budget, add a service, change sites or the connection. We'll show what breaks, why, and the smallest change that fixes it. Nothing changes until you pick an option.
whatif.no_gst: I don't have an active GST registration any more
whatif.essential: Mark what you can't do without
whatif.choose: Not everything fits. Pick the option that matters most to you.
